POV: you finally found the good Bún Quậy.

Bún quậy THIỆN MỸ on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is the real deal. 4.7 stars across 423 reviews. Under $10 a head. The locals eating here at noon tell you everything you need to know.

Bún quậy is Phu Quoc's own noodle dish. You won't find it like this back home. Order it, stir it, eat it fast.
